lessons.title: Introduction to Java and Spring Boot
lessons.description: In this lesson, we will cover the basics of Java and Spring Boot. We will start with an overview of Java, including its syntax, data types, control structures, and object-oriented programming concepts. We will then introduce Spring Boot, its features, and how to set up a basic Spring Boot project. By the end of this lesson, you should be able to write a simple Spring Boot application.

lessons.title: Advanced Java and Spring Boot Concepts
lessons.description: In this lesson, we will delve deeper into advanced Java and Spring Boot concepts. We will cover topics such as dependency injection, configuration management, and Spring Boot's auto-configuration feature. We will also explore how to use Spring Boot's security features and how to integrate Spring Boot with external databases. By the end of this lesson, you should be able to create more complex applications and understand how to optimize your Spring Boot applications.

lessons.title: Building a Professional Java with Spring Boot Application
lessons.description: In this final lesson, we will put all the knowledge we have gained together to build a professional Java with Spring Boot application. We will work on a real-world project, starting from the initial design and moving through the development process. We will cover topics such as unit testing, integration testing, and performance optimization. By the end of this lesson, you should be able to create a robust and maintainable Java application using Spring Boot.
